highlights_headline: Upcoming Skia m157 servicing hardens mask-filtered glyph rendering against inconsistent font-scaler output.

bullets.lead: Reloaded glyph paths and masks stay consistent
bullets.detail: Uses the reloaded glyph's own outline or raster image instead of stale path state. Incompatible or non-overlapping masks produce cleared output rather than invalid copies, and clipped embossed glyphs use full plane strides. This prevents sub-byte overwrites and corrupted mask planes without changing managed APIs.
